lead_qualifications: The appended clarification supersedes several overclaims in the initial review.
A moment count is only an order condition, not proof of identification.
Bound hits do not prove incompatible targets or identify a parameter with one moment.
Do not import the BGM 0.45 transitory-variance multiplier into the different project income concept as an estimated correction.
No economic adoption thresholds such as ownership above0.55 or half of a previous loss gap have been accepted.
Rental support expansion, rental price slope, owner premium and intercept require separate controls.
Estate liquidation and deterministic tenure remain substantive author choices.
Frozen-source versus active-source facts must be checked before use.
